story.text: A very special island is inhabited only by altruists and egoists. Altruists always tell the truth, and egoists always lie. You meet 2 inhabitants: Riley, and Evelyn. Riley told you that Evelyn is an egoist or Riley is an altruist. As Evelyn put it, "if Evelyn is an altruist then Riley is an altruist". So who is an altruist and who is an egoist? (Format your answer like: "Riley is a altruist/egoist, and Evelyn is a altruist/egoist")

options: Riley is an egoist, Evelyn is an altruist
Riley is an altruist, Evelyn is an altruist
Riley is an egoist, Evelyn is an egoist
Riley is an altruist, Evelyn is an egoist

Riley 说：“（Evelyn是an egoist）或者（Riley是an altruist）”
Evelyn 说：“如果（Evelyn是an altruist）那么（Riley是an altruist）”

Riley 是利他者，Evelyn 是利他者
Riley 是利己者，Evelyn 是利己者
